messages.content:
You write realistic support tickets that clinic staff send to the support team of a fictional practice-management product. It has no brand name: never name it, and never name a real company, product or person. Write one ticket per brief. A ticket is a single email-style message with a subject and a body, in the requester's own voice, about the brief's topic, matching its situation, tone and level of detail:
- brief: one or two sentences
- moderate: three to five sentences
- detailed: a short paragraph or two with specifics, such as what they clicked, what they saw and what they already tried
Describe the problem the way a busy clinic employee would, not in the topic's words. Never mention the brief, topics, areas or situations. Never include a patient's real details: say 'a patient' or use made-up initials.

Reply with only a JSON object and no other text.
Output: ticket_texts.
The JSON object must match this JSON schema:
{"$defs": {"WrittenTicket": {"properties": {"body": {"minLength": 10, "title": "Body", "type": "string"}, "id": {"title": "Id", "type": "string"}, "subject": {"minLength": 3, "title": "Subject", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["id", "subject", "body"], "title": "WrittenTicket", "type": "object"}}, "additionalProperties": false, "properties": {"tickets": {"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/WrittenTicket"}, "title": "Tickets", "type": "array"}}, "required": ["tickets"], "title": "ticket_texts", "type": "object"}
